limitations: The hosted verify.yml step re-verifies byte equality of the committed fallback block against the pinned package on every pull request; this is byte-level provenance only and is not formal XAML, accessibility, driver, WaveRT, signing, installer, or release evidence.

The pinned nupkg SHA-512 and generic.xaml SHA-256 are hard-wired to version 1.7.250401001; the gate fails closed if apps/winui-shell/Hibiki.WinUI.csproj pins a different version, and a future SDK bump must update the gate constants and re-verify.
The hosted verification depends on network access to nuget.org with bounded retries; a transient nuget.org outage fails the gate visibly instead of silently skipping verification.

No claim of physical audio, driver, WaveRT, signing, installer, or release readiness; the committed dictionary in apps/winui-shell/App.xaml.cs is verified, not regenerated, and no product source, schema, wire, DSP, or build contract is modified.
